5 open-source Realtek projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Realtek chips and drivers. 4 of 5 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: rtl-sdr, LibreTiny, ltchiptool, rtl8196e-gateway, realtek-libohwtc.

  1. rtl-sdr★ 1,013 · active · C

    Turns RTL2832U DVB-T dongles into SDR receivers via reverse-engineered debug mode

  2. LibreTiny★ 554 · active · C

    Arduino/PlatformIO support for Beken/Realtek chips used in Tuya and other IoT devices

  3. ltchiptool★ 236 · active · Python

    GUI and CLI flashing and dumping tool for BK7231, RTL8710B and RTL8720C chips in Tuya devices

  4. rtl8196e-gateway★ 229 · active · C

    Open-source Linux firmware for RTL8196E smart home gateways like Lidl Silvercrest

  5. realtek-libohwtc★ 17 · slowing · C

    Library enabling Huawei proprietary OMCI MEs on Realtek RTL9601 GPON SFP sticks
